#+title: habshe-emacs — bootstrap
#+author: A. Shehab (habshehabshe)

The tangled init.el: custom-file relocation, the package system,
and the explicit module load order. Load order is load-bearing:
the package installer before any package's config module, and
keybindings last, always.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp :tangle "../init.el"
  ;;; init.el --- GENERATED from org/init.org — do not edit -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-

  ;; custom-file keeps Customize-UI scribbles out of this generated file
  ;; (which the next tangle would silently overwrite). setq is deliberate:
  ;; cus-edit is not loaded yet, so `setopt' cannot see the option. The file
  ;; is gitignored machine state; nothing in these modules may depend on
  ;; its contents.
  (setq custom-file (expand-file-name "custom.el" user-emacs-directory))
  (when (file-exists-p custom-file)
    (load custom-file t t))

  ;; Archives and priorities only. Installation is owned by my-emacs-packages;
  ;; configuration by the individual my-* modules.
  (require 'package)
  (setopt package-archives
          '(("gnu-elpa" . "https://elpa.gnu.org/packages/")
            ("nongnu-elpa" . "https://elpa.nongnu.org/nongnu/")
            ("melpa" . "https://melpa.org/packages/")))
  (setopt package-archive-priorities
          '(("gnu-elpa" . 3)
            ("melpa" . 2)
            ("nongnu-elpa" . 1)))
  ;; Activate what is installed. early-init suppressed the automatic
  ;; activation so it happens here, at our chosen point.
  (package-activate-all)

  ;; Order: installer first (so packages exist before their config
  ;; modules load), then behavior modules; keybindings load last
  ;; because they reference commands from every module.
  (add-to-list 'load-path (expand-file-name "lisp" user-emacs-directory))

  (require 'my-emacs-packages)             ; installs the manifest
  (require 'my-emacs-files)                ; litter redirection
  (require 'my-emacs-frames)               ; theme, fonts, title, tooltips
  (require 'my-emacs-buffers)              ; line numbers, highlight, wrapping
  (require 'my-emacs-windows)              ; buffer display policy
  (require 'my-emacs-editing)              ; selection / line editing
  (require 'my-whole-line-or-region)       ; whole-line kill/copy fallback
  (require 'my-yasnippet)                  ; snippet expansion
  (require 'my-emacs-completions)          ; the completion menu
  (require 'my-orderless)                  ; fuzzy matching
  (require 'my-marginalia)                 ; menu annotations
  (require 'my-emacs-keybindings)          ; bindings — always last
  #+end_src
